title: Monumental Vanilla+
description: Stop playing in a box and start exploring a world without limits.
body:
Monumental Vanilla+ redefines the scale of Minecraft, combining the breathtaking, realistic terrain of Tectonic with the infinite vistas of Distant Horizons. Experience the classic game you love, enhanced with stunning cinematic visuals, New Vanilla friendly animals, Backpacks, fast travel Waystones, a slot just for your elytra so you can wear armor and your elytra together, countless quality of life changes and so much more!

# Features
Completly overhauled Vanilla friendly world and End generation to make exploration never boring.

1000+ new achievements that are all vanilla friendly.

Many new Vanilla friendly animals.

Overhauled and new Villages, Illager outposts and more.

Tons of fan favourite QoL features.

The best performance mods to keep the game running smooth for any PC.

Pre configured Distant Horizons mod to run smooth on any low - high end PC and is fully configurable to how ever you like also with a Pre configured Shader installed that works seamlesly with Distant Horizons.

Better textures plus new and animated textures for the player and all mobs.

Custom main menu.

100+ Vanilla friendly Mods.

# Important info
You must allocate at least 6GB and no more than 10GB max memory for this modpack to function as intended otherwise chunks may gltich or not load properly.

Shaders and Texture packs are optional but highly recommended.

If you encounter any issues please contact me through my Discord server. [Join here](https://discord.gg/cxF5fbzN)
